title: The VMM must, at a minimum, off-load interconnected systems in real time and off-load standalone systems weekly.
check_content:
Verify the VMM, at a minimum, off-loads interconnected systems in real time and off-loads standalone systems weekly.

If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the VMM to, at a minimum, off-load interconnected systems in real time and off-load standalone systems weekly.
VulnDiscussion:
Information stored in one location is vulnerable to accidental or incidental deletion or alteration.

Off-loading is a common process in VMMs with limited audit storage capacity.
